name: novel-characters
description: Construct causal character bibles and relationship state in provider-safe structured batches.
procedure: Derive a differentiated ensemble from the author's goal and existing story.
Give each major character conflicting wants, needs, beliefs, secrets, and leverage.
Create or update character profiles and relationships with the ordinary project tools.
Record deeper character notes and unresolved decisions in project docs.
Choose the next step from the author's goal and current project state; keep progress in project docs and verify persisted tool results.
